[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]One live agent per numbered workspace — close the monitor claim [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]hole[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A numbered `<project>_<N>` workspace checkout is never occupied by [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]two live agents at once. Every process that works inside a numbered[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace holds the RUNNING-field claim for that exact number for [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]as long as it is in there, the claim's PID is always a live [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]process, and any code path that cannot satisfy that invariant fails[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]loudly instead of silently running unclaimed.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record the agent's real workspace number in agent_meta.json[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]meta[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]meta: write and maintain `workspace_num` in every agent's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`agent_meta.json` so downstream consumers stop reading `None`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Authoritative workspace-directory to workspace-number lookup[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]lookup[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lookup: add a registry-backed helper that resolves a checkout directory [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to its owning workspace number.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A monitor holds the claim on the workspace it runs in[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-claim[dim] · [dim][/dim]after meta, lookup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-claim: replace the silent `workspace_num = 0` fallback in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor start so the monitor always claims the numbered workspace its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command runs in, or refuses to start.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A monitor handoff never orphans the starter's claim[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]orphan[dim] · [dim][/dim]after monitor-claim[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]orphan: make the runner's `monitored` shutdown skip conditional on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]claim actually having moved to a live supervisor, so a dead-PID claim is[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never left behind for the stale-claim reaper.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Follow-up and family-attach launches never pair workspace 0 [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]with a numbered directory[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]followup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after meta, lookup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]followup: normalize workspace number and directory together in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor follow-up and family-attach launch paths so a degraded launch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]moves out of the numbered workspace instead of squatting in it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unclaimed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The commit finalizer stops attributing pre-existing dirt to [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]the agent[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]finalizer[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]finalizer: capture a dirty-path baseline at runner start and exclude [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]those paths from the finalizer's must-commit set, reporting them as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pre-existing instead.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Occupancy diagnostics and an end-to-end regression exercise[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after monitor-claim, orphan, followup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: add doctor/inventory diagnostics for unclaimed-but-occupied and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]double-occupied workspaces, plus a regression test that replays the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]original incident sequence.[/#D7D7AF]
